budget_items.topic: Public Access Committee anticipated FY25 income
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Anticipated FY25 income is listed as Comcast, regular interest and bond interest, totalling $238,763, or $207,803 after reserve funds.

budget_items.topic: Proposed state streaming media fee bill
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A proposed bill would impose a 5% fee on digital streaming providers, with State-collected monies split 20% to the state general fund and 40% each to municipalities and community media. Steve Walker said the town is still waiting for information on whether it applies to Lunenburg.
budget_items.quote: this is a proposition of a 5% fee on digital streaming providers,
